findings.problem: House rule broken: text dimmed far below 0.8 opacity and held. While a new word is being checked the whole verdict badge is dimmed to 0.35 (line 185, V.show(badgeBox, 1 - 0.65 * pend)) and stays so for 1.2 s (local 3.15 to 4.35, two-flip check) and again for 1.4 s (local 6.15 to 7.55, burst check). The badge text 'clean' (34 px, dark-green -on shade on the green fill) falls from 6.12:1 to about 1.55:1, so a half-faded 'clean' badge sits beside a red-flipped frame while the remainder still reads 000. It looks like a ghost verdict and, worse, still says 'clean' next to a damaged frame.
findings.fix: Do not half-dim. Fade the whole group out and bring the next verdict in with its own pop: change line 185 to V.show(badgeBox, 1 - pend) (pend already ramps 0 to 1 over 0.25 s from the start of each PENDING window, so the old badge is gone by 3.25 and 6.25; at 4.5 and 7.7 the window ends and badge('invalid', k) pops in from k = 0 as designed). Alternative: draw a neutral grey badge 'checking' while pending. Either way no text may sit between 0.1 and 0.8 opacity.
findings.evidence: DOM scan of every sample (0.2 s steps): the only text in the video that sits at 0.1 < opacity < 0.8 for more than 0.6 s is the badge span 'clean', min opacity 0.35, global 42.65-43.85 and 45.65-47.05. Stills s5@3.5 and s5@6.5 (washed-out 'clean' badge next to the red flipped tiles and green 000 remainder). Contrast computed from the rendered colours: 6.12:1 at full opacity, 1.55:1 at 0.35.

findings.problem: 12 px stage margin broken: the grey 'sent' tag is placed at stage y 0 (line 44, y: 0), so it touches the top of the stage, only about 22 px under the second headline line, for the whole first half of the scene. Its rect is [150, 0, 250, 62]. (The tag is 62 px high, not 58.)
findings.fix: Move the sent row down 14 px and the tag to y 12: set SENT_Y = 86 (line 23) and sentTag y: 12 (line 44). LANE_FROM is derived (SENT_Y + SIZE + 12 = 182), so the lanes, the bolt (LANE_MID) and the 'wire' tag follow; the received row and everything after local 5.4 are unchanged. Tag bottom 74, tile top 86, so the 12 px gap to the tiles is kept.
findings.evidence: Stage-rect scan: 'sent' tag top = 0 px from global 4.45 to 9.25 (local 0.45-5.25). Still s2@2.0 (global 6.0): tag top at canvas y 262, directly under the headline.

findings.problem: Two tags are a few pixels short of the 12 px stage margin: 'message' at stage y 8 (line 47, rect [600, 8, 760, 70]) and 'add 000' at y 10 (line 69, rect [385, 10, 535, 72]). Both are 62 px high and sit 6 px above the tiles at y 76, so they cannot simply move down.
findings.fix: Shift the right column and the division rows 4 px lower (every y in the layout +4: msgTag 12, msg 80, genTag 154, gen 222, bothTag/xorTag 300, remTag 382, addTag 14, and the division y 76 -> 80); the frame row at y 520 has about 70 px spare below. Or leave as is, the overshoot is 2 to 4 px and invisible at video scale.
findings.evidence: Stage-rect scan: top 8 px ('message', global 27.25-39.45) and 10 px ('add 000', global 30.05-39.45).

findings.problem: The two panel cards are flush with the stage: x 0 to 936 and panel A at y 0 (rect [0, 0, 936, 280]), so they have a 0 px margin instead of 12 px. They line up with the progress bar and headline edge (x 72 and 1008), which looks deliberate, but it is the only element in the video that breaks the margin rule on the left and right.
findings.fix: Optional: inset the cards 12 px (x 12, width 912, panel A y 12, panel B y 336; panel B then ends at 616, still inside) and shift the sender stub to x 28 and the receiver stub to x 778 so the inner spacing is unchanged. Skip if the full-width alignment with the progress bar is preferred.
findings.evidence: Stage-rect scan: v-card.plain.c-grey rect [0, 0, 936, 280] and [0, 330, 936, 610] from global 56.65 (local 6.15) to the end of the scene. Still s6@6.2.

findings.problem: The counter bump (scale 1.1 for 0.3 s each time a group is counted, line 155) closes the 12 px gap between the 'ones' card (x 180 to 450 at rest) and the 'odd: failed' tag (x 462): at the peak the card is 294 px wide and its right edge touches the tag. For about 0.3 s two stickers look glued together.
findings.fix: Move the verdict tag 12 px right (x 474) or lower the bump to 1.05. The scene 8 counters and scene 3 counter have wider gaps and are fine.
findings.evidence: Rect scan at global 95.0 (local 6.5): stat 'ones 3' [168, 521, 462, 607] and tag 'odd: failed' [462, 534, 653, 598]. Still s9@6.5.

findings.problem: The API comment for A6.card (line 46) says 'plain = white face'. The code correctly uses var(--panel) (video.css .v-card.plain), but the comment invites a future edit to hard-code white, and a grep for 'white' in the sources hits it.
findings.fix: Reword to 'plain = the panel face with the tone's edge, false = the tone's tint'.
findings.evidence: grep -n white videos/a6/*.js: the only hit that is not a legitimate whiteSpace style is common-2.js line 46.
